build_prefill_attention_wave: build a memory-efficient attention kernel for prefill phase with page size 1 support
create_attention_shape: create an AttentionShape configuration from query, key, value tensor shapes and sequence lengths
run_prefill_attention_kernel: run the prefill attention wave kernel with qkv tensors, batch location, and sequence length inputs
compile_wave_kernel: compile a prefill attention kernel with WaveCompileOptions and default scheduling parameters
dump_generated_mlir: dump generated MLIR module to file when WAVE_DUMP_MLIR environment variable is set
